strength.$body:
According to the QMDJ Compendium by Joey Yap (pg. 410), the strength of a door is based on the Solar Term of the plotted chart time. Furthermore, the strength is shifted by (1) month.  For eg. Rest Door, of Water element, does not reach its peak at the point of Winter Solstice. According to Joey Yap, it reaches its peak in Minor Cold, which is 1 month past Winter Solstice. For consistency, we have assigned numeric values to the terms chosen by Joey Yap.

Prosperous: 8
Abandoned: 7
Weak: 6
Trap: 5
Death: 4
Absent: 5
Conceived: 6
Strong: 7

We have consolidated the terminology such that it reflects the numeric scale. Strong is synonymous with Abandoned.  Trap is synonymous with Absent.  Weak is synonymous with Conceived.

Abandoned — Strong
Weak — Weak
Trap — Trap

rest.$body:
The Rest Door is the gateway to serenity — a place where the breeze carries the scent of the blue sea.  It can be visualized as a joyous puppy rolling around in the soft, white sand.

When one enters the Rest Door, tension tends to fade and is replaced by a sense of clarity.  One will be able to look at problems from a big-picture perspective, enabling the discovery of creative solutions that was never once considered.  Relationships with others will mend and bond as self-centeredness gives way to a great whole.  Those born with the Rest Door have the wisdom and empathy to understand that the moments in life are to be delicately savored.

life.$body:
The Life Door is the gateway to growth — a catalyst to progress any situation or event.  It is visualized as a sprawling metropolis with obsessed individuals working every waking hour to build a civilization of maximal production.  The Life Door is considered the most desired of all doors because it can be applied to amass extraordinary amounts of wealth or power.

When one enters the Life Door, an immediate boost is applied to the situation in focus.  Those born with this door in their palace often notice an unmistakable desire for advancement and progression.  Those with this door find themselves able to recover from illness or harm quicker than others.  The Life Door is a symbol of monumental potential.  It would be wise to carefully plan the trajectory before applying the Life Door to the situation.  Otherwise, the situation may advance to a state where one may not have intended.

harm.$body:
The Harm Door is a gateway to victory.  It can be visualized as a gladiator sacrificing his safety to defeat the enemy at all costs.  He who remains standing is the champion.

When utilized properly, this door can bring tremendous force to stop an opponent from achieving their goal.  It is considered a door of last resort, as it is known for its devastating and immediate effects.  When one enters the door, he shall find that while victory can be quickly secured, it is without the absence of collateral damage.  Those born with the Harm Door are thrill seekers who welcome risk and volatility.  They do not look at life as a smooth sailing river but rather a dangerous jungle to be explored and paved.

delusion.$body:
The Delusion Door is the gateway to concealment -- a dark cave where one can be kept safe from the dangers of the world.  It is the invisibility cloak that allows the mage to avoid attention.

When one enters the Delusion Door, he is hidden from plain sight.  Spoken words cannot be heard.  The visible becomes a blur.  Enemies are ignorant of your intentions as their sources of information is now contaminated.  It is a door for secrecy, planning, and learning new subjects.  Those who are born with the Delusion Door will find that stepping back from chaotic situations and retreating to safety will come at ease.

The Scenery Door is the gateway to perception — a splendid costume giving the wearer an unmistakable aura of charisma.  It can be visualized as a beautiful model strolling down the the runway with perfect form.

This door is a picture of fame and success.   When one enters the Scenery Door, their voice can be assured that it will travel far and wide.  Statements become definitive and persuasive; ideas become charming and creative.  This door is best used for purposes of sales and marketing, as the audience will surely find the magnetic attraction a sight to behold.  Those born with the Scenery Door have a controlling presence in social situations.  They project a feeling of optimistic enthusiasm that can easily take the world by storm.

death.$body:
The Death Door is the gateway to renewal.  It is the end of the road but also the beginning of a new adventure.  It can be visualized as a seed waiting to sprout into the essence of nature.

When one enters the Death Door, he will be able to understand the circle of life.  Dualities of black and white, strong and weak, hard and soft become one and the same.  One will cease to become selfish, as they will see themselves as part of a greater whole.  The Death Door is the giver of emotions.  Those who are born with it have the ability to experience intense connectedness to the people and things around them.  The Death Door can bring an individual to the final stage of spiritual enlightenment.

fear.$body:
The Fear Door is the gateway to uncertainty.  Even the strongest of willpower can fall to the slightest touch of doubt.  The Fear Door can be visualized as an owl who gazes into the eyes of a beast, offering the savage a minute image of itself.

When one enters the Fear Door, he sends to his enemies a charge of intimidation that even the most confident cannot dismiss.  He sends his subordinates an empowering message.  This door acts by non-action.  The strong may doubt their strength.  The weak may notice their power.  Those born with the Fear Door possess an ability to influence those around them by offering a hypnotic mirror for reflection.

open.$body:
The Open Door is the gateway to new beginnings — the mark of opportunity and hope in human progress.  It can visualized as a young, energetic startup aiming to tackle the existing market.

When one enters the Open Door, events tend to unfold in positive ways and obstacles seem to disappear.  Others will exhibit a receptive nature to novel proposals.  As the first of the eight doors, the Open Door is associated with proactive change.  Those with the Open Door in their palace will find that taking the role of a visionary or innovator will be most beneficial as opposed to following a preexisting flow of doing things. Those around them are already predestined to follow their steps.

strength.$body:
The strength of a star is based on the element of the palace in which it resides.  According to the QMDJ Compendium by Joey Yap (pg. 548), a star does [not] reach its peak when it lands in a palace of identical element.  Rather, a star reaches its peak when it lands in a palace of the element that it produces.

For example: Heavenly Assistant, a star of Wood, does not reach peak in the Wood palaces of Zhen and Xun.  Rather, it reaches peak in Li, a Fire palace, because (according to Joey Yap), the effects of the star is more noticeable.

The current strength calculation is based on this approach. A linear model that aligns directly with the 12 Stages of Growth may be added as a future option.

Those born with the Grass are instilled with a desire to turn their imaginations into fruition.  Their ambition may lead them to over-indulge in rewards earned from their efforts.

grain.$body: The Heavenly Grain is governs stability.  It is the stone that cannot be broken.  As the biggest and most radiant of the Nine Stars, the Grain acts as a conservative anchor for the dualistic aspects of nature.   It enables the individual to be in-tune with their personal moral compass, giving a sense of what is right or wrong.  Those born with the Grain are often grounded in life, preferring to take matters one step at a time.  They are prone to risk aversion, as they prefer to grasp the security of the future rather than be surprised by it.  They maintain a small circle of trusted friends and place extreme loyalty to the chosen ones.

For example: Heavenly Assistant, a star of Wood, does not reach peak in the Wood palaces of Zhen and Xun.  Rather, it reaches peak in Li, a Fire palace, because (according to Joey Yap), the effects of the star is more noticeable.

The current strength calculation is based on this approach. A linear model that aligns directly with the 12 Stages of Growth may be added as a future option.

It emits a force of interconnectedness, and those who wield its powers can bring people together and accomplish monumental achievements.  The Heavenly Bird naturally attracts noble people to join one’s cause and is highly preferred for use in business and new ventures.  The Bird resides in the center of the social circle and is the intermediary among all other entities.  Those born with the Bird find an innate ability to mediate and resolve conflicts with little effort.

This star strikes the perfect balance of firmness and softness.  The Heart Star carries with it the essence of longevity, honor, and prosperity.  Those born with this star possess the sensitivity to connect with their tribe, giving the tribe a magical source of healing power. Respect arrives naturally due to their altruistic nature for the group.

Due to their competitive and ambitious nature, individuals with the Pillar are often too stubborn and straightforward to identify all opportunities ahead.  Blazing ahead could cause destruction, but they often feel such damage is necessary to achieve a meaningful result.  They feel it is an inner duty to be socially responsible, and they will strive to master all skills necessary to push for their cause.

It is an intensely auspicious star which can provide one with resources and assets to continue advancing forward.  One who utilize this star properly will find that support and aid is always at the side — one will not have to adventure alone.  This star is particularly favored for business, war, and education. Those born with the Ambassador star will be relentlessly resourceful as they can find utility and value in any tool available to them.

Those born with the Hero are seekers of new experiences and live life on the edge of tomorrow.  They will enter the darkness with no hesitation, lighting a fire for those behind to follow.

chief.$body:
The Chief — the First — is the commander of the universal realm and the head of the Nine Spirits.  A direct manifestation of the Tao itself, the Chief is the source of ten thousand things — and from it, life springs into existence.  Where the Chief walks, flowers blossom into prosperity.

The Chief is depicted by an Emperor who possesses the natural qualities of righteousness, justice, and honor.  People follow him because he inspires and instills the pinnacle of integrity.

One who possesses the guardian of the Chief is said to be invincible to negative energies, forever protected by the source of the divine itself till the end of time.  With great power comes great responsibility, and the Chief must fulfill his destiny to bring positive guidance to the world.

The Snake emanates from the fire the qualities of truth and fantasy — of what is reality or a dream.  It is the spirit intertwining mystery and complexity.  When the Snake slithers into being, the known becomes the unknown, fact becomes fiction, and distortion becomes reality.

 The Snake is depicted by a mystical sorcerer with the ability to sense nearby energies and connect to the emotional tunnel of others.  Legend says that those with the Snake can influence the weather.

One who possesses the spirit of the Snake finds the ability to manipulate the world using enhanced abilities of cunningness and wit, sharpness and speed.  One must be careful not to fall to the dark side, for the abilities of the Snake can often be too powerful and alluring for the individual to handle.

When the sun descends, the Moon rises as the mythical spirit of shadow and mystery.  It is the river of the great unknown — drifting, wandering, and forever seeking.

The Moon is depicted by a wise sage with an uncontrollable desire for answers to his existence.  Of the Nine Spirits, the Moon possesses the deepest aspiration for knowledge — especially secret, unattainable knowledge.  With knowledge comes satisfaction and power — and it is through this path that the Moon finds his destiny.

Those with the spirit of the Moon have the ability to understand esoteric subjects without a rational explanation.  Their mind is like water, exploring the edges of the hidden cave and hoping to find the treasure that is truth.  With great intuition, they are able to discover forbidden secrets that others cannot and will never obtain.

The spirit of Six Harmony is the embodiment of purity and unity.  Whenever darkness spreads across the land, Six Harmony blooms to bring light and optimism once again.

Six Harmony is depicted as a graceful maiden at a family gathering spreading the aura of blessing and love.  They are social butterflies who can emphasize and connect with anyone they come across.  Legend says that during the great Heavenly Battles, only the Six Harmony was able to sacrifice herself and restore peace and serenity to the world.

Often associated with happiness and positivity, the Six Harmony possesses an innate ability to mediate and mend relationships.  They are masters at balance — being the only spirit who can create win-win situations in all cases.  They are truly selfless individuals, because they understand that their existence is only a small part of the whole.

At the crown of Polaris, one will find the Grappling Hook overlooking earth’s passage of time.  This magnificent spirit governs the ancestral past of man, slowly threading the fabric connecting the past and the present.

Legend says that the Hook is a lone warrior presiding over all wars and conflicts of the human world.  The Hook strives to win at all costs, utilizing its vast library of history to systematically plan a route to success.  Due to their reputation for being merciless and vengeful, they are often feared in the mythical realm.

Those who possess the spirit of the Hook have the innate ability to understand the cause and effect of all events.  They are connected to the roots of nature and have an uncanny power to heal and rejuvenate via natural foods and herbs.

The spirit of White Tiger guards over the vessel of energy used by all forms of life in the universe.  When summoned properly, this spirit can unleash a boundless force capable of either complete annihilation or creation.

This spirit is depicted as a beast of the jungle which has managed to survive for hundreds of years, bearing in a near-immortal being dusted in white snow.  The White Tiger are revered by the creatures of the land and sky, for they know that it can transform from elegance to viciousness in the blink of an eye.

Those with this spirit will discover an unlimited source of stamina to achieve prolific achievements.  They are able to endure pain and hardships at magnitudes far beyond the average being.  The White Tiger acts and does not speak; fights and does not surrender; rises and does not fall.

The Red Phoenix is the guardian of communications and transmissions.  As ideas rise from the fire and spread with the wind, the Phoenix oversees their propagation into the cultural essence of civilization.

This fabled creature radiates an ambience of inspiration, and it is through this ambience that generations of humanity have been moved and swayed.  The legendary Cao Cao of the Three Kingdoms commanded a charismatic voice that neither ally nor foe could ignore, escalating him to the highest spheres of power.

With the tongue of the Phoenix, one can turn lies into reality, the distasteful into the beautiful, and the ordinary into the extraordinary.  Arguments are rarely lost; reputation is rarely shattered.  He who is born with this spirit can persuade his peers into thinking and acting in any way he so desires.

This mystical creature is legendary for its portrayal as the lord of the sea in the novel Journey to the West.  It is a deity so powerful that some claim simply being in its presence is akin to entering a tunnel of hypnosis.

When properly trained, the Black Tortoise can sense the emotions, desires, and vibrations of others.  The ability to plant seeds into the subconscious minds has given the Black Tortoise an undeserved reputation of dark sorcery.  As such, one must be careful to ensure that such arcane magic is only used to help others in a positive way.

The Nine Earth is the gentle mother of nature responsible for the stability of life on earth, ensuring that chaos and order remains in balance.  This spirit has watched over earth’s resources since the beginning, closely nurturing its child from generation to generation.  In the distant past, the Nine Earth was appreciatively worshipped for her ability to bring water and crops to the people.  The Nine Earth is depicted as a perfect circle — a symbol of eternal life and death.

As the most benevolent spirit of all, individuals who possess Nine Earth places the prosperity of others above themselves.  They are grounded personalities who take matters one step at a time, preferring not to shake the foundation that has been carefully constructed over time.  The Nine Earth instills calmness and compassion into the individual, a gift that brings along a healthy body and long life.

heaven.$body:
The Nine Heaven rules over the skies that man cannot touch.  S/he is the ultimate symbol of man’s dreams and aspirations — of unlimited potential and optimistic transformation.  While man experiences the present time on earth, the Nine Heaven governs the possible realities of the future.

5000 years ago, when he Yellow Emperor was losing the final battle with the invincible tyrant Chi You, legend has it that the Goddess of Nine Heavens came down into the Emperor’s dream to teach him what is now known as the most powerful divination tool known to man — Qi Men Dun Jia.  With this technique, the Yellow Emperor was able to predict the enemy’s next action, winning the war in his favor.

Today, those who possess the spirit of Nine Heaven are known to be experiencers of synchronicity and visionaries of alternate dimensions.  They can project vivid details of probable realities in their subconscious minds, manifesting those realities that they desire.  As the only spirit with this self-fulfilling ability, the magician of Nine Heaven must be careful what he wishes for.

Finance, investments, and trade are benefited, and fortune may come.

One will then find the motivation necessary to climb upwards.

✭ Star Prospers 星旺.description: This auspicoius formation depicts the Ding noble wandering into a garden of dreams.  One may find that their goals will come closer to achievement.  Insights will spring into the mind, allowing one to utilize streams of creativity to further advance.  The horizon of aspirations stretches far and wide.

✭ super assisting 相佐格.description: This formation is suitable for forming relationships with others -- gaining new allies and friends, seeking knowledge from mentors, and reestablshing old ties. With persistence, success will not be unattainable.

✭ three wonder spirit 三奇之靈.name: three wonder spirit
✭ three wonder spirit 三奇之靈.description: This auspicious formation will help one develop a clear path as one strives forward.  Strengths and weaknesses will be revealed.  This formation does not automatically guarantee success, but will come to great aid if preparation and planning is in order.

⨂ entangled snake 勝蛇妖嬌.description: Gui water rains on flame.  An entangled snake is one which cannot smoothly proceed without conflict.  One will find that in order to reach a conclusion, small and minor issues must be resolved before giant steps can be taken.

⨂ green dragon runs away 青龍逃走.name: green dragon runs away
⨂ green dragon runs away 青龍逃走.description: The Green Dragon indicates prosperity and fortune, but this formation indicates that the confident energy is absent.  One should think twice before making dramatic changes.  It is advised to take the calm road at this moment.

⨂ sparrow dives into river 朱雀投江.name: sparrow dives into river
⨂ sparrow dives into river 朱雀投江.description: Arguments and conflicts may escalate into serious battles.  When the Ding wonder enters water, the flame is lost.

⨂ shimmering white 熒惑入白.name: shimmering white
⨂ shimmering white 熒惑入白.description: Also known as Mars Enters Venus.  Time will be the most valuable asset, as this structure suggests danger lurking ahead.  One should look for obstacles and traps before pushing forward into battle.  Wisdom suggests reconsidering one's options -- perhaps finding an alternate route to the destination.

⨂ white enters dark 太白入熒.name: white enters dark
⨂ white enters dark 太白入熒.description: Also known as Venus Enters Mars, this formation favors the guest and suppresses the host.  Geng metal is the enemy of Jia, and this special formation depicts a rising inauspicious light.  One should approach the matter proactively (as the guest) in order to secure the victory.

⨂ punishment 刑格.name: punishment
⨂ punishment 刑格.description: This inauspicious formation depicts a pattern of chaos spiralling out of control.  Geng meets with Ji to trap the Jia.  Not suitable for financial decisions, legal entanglements, negotiations, or disputes

⨂ war configuration 戰格.name: war configuration
⨂ war configuration 戰格.description: This inauspicious formation suggests tragic loss and disaster.  With both Geng metals as the stems, danger could lie ahead if one is not careful.

⨂ three wonders setting 奇格.name: three wonders setting
⨂ three wonders setting 奇格.description: Geng is the mortal enemy of Jia.  In this inauspicious combination, Geng metal combines with one of the Three Wonders -- Yi, Bing, and Ding.  This formation is not suitable for matters related to conflict or competition.  One must be careful when dealing with money matters.  If Yi is combined, Guest is favored.  If Bing or Ding is combined, Host is favored.

⨂ flying stem 飛干格.name: flying stem
⨂ flying stem 飛干格.description: Obstacles reveal themselves every day, but this one will affect one's relationship in the professional world.  This inauspicious formation creates problems for the individual.

⨂ big configuration 大格.name: big configuration
⨂ big configuration 大格.description: This inauspicious formation illustrates that an important element of the solution is missing.  One cannot proceed without having a complete set of tools and support for the situation.

⨂ small configuration 小格.name: small configuration
⨂ small configuration 小格.description: This inauspicious structure depicts a military strategist trapped in a continuous mental cycle with no new ideas to proceed.  This structure directly affects the ego and self esteem of an individual, limiting his ability to formulate.

⨂ flying palace 天乙飛宮格.name: flying palace
⨂ flying palace 天乙飛宮格.description: This inauspicious formation harms both host and guest.  It depicts that although a general can control his troops, he cannot control the weather.  Forces outside of the general's control will throw curve his plans, which may need to be adapted to the new environment.

⨂ sitting palace 天乙伏宮格.name: sitting palace
⨂ sitting palace 天乙伏宮格.description: This formation indicates a loss of leadership vission.  Subordinates may lose faith; co-workers may distrust.  The mission will stagnate as obstacles will emerge to hinder progress.  The future is blurry, and one should tread carefully when making decisions.

⨂ three wonders in tomb 月奇入基.name: three wonders in tomb
⨂ three wonders in tomb 月奇入基.description: The Three Wonders (Yi, Bing, Ding) is the cornerstone of Qi Men Dun Jia.  In this formation, a Wonder is in tomb (palace).  Efforts will slowly progress.  Positive matters will turn negative.  Support will dwindle and relationships may be impacted.  Critical decisions are better off delayed as the storm passes.  At this point, hesitation may be a wise choice.

⨂ three wonders suppressed 三奇受制.name: three wonders suppressed
⨂ three wonders suppressed 三奇受制.description: This neutral formation indicates one of the Three Wonders landing in a palace that supresses its strength.  As the job of a Wonder is to protect the Jia, this formation suggests that the Wonder is unable to perform its duty to the fullest extent.  However, hope is not lost.

⨂ six crest strike penalty 六儀擊刑.name: six crest strike penalty
⨂ six crest strike penalty 六儀擊刑.description: The Six Crest Penalty is an inauspicious formation that denotes an individual being pressed against a wall from all sides, leaving no room for escape.  This causes an emotional disaster, as the individual is forced to make a choice with no positive outcome.
